results.title: Techiman North inaugurates 58 sanitation guards to boost cleanliness and create jobs
results.content: The Techiman North District Assembly has inaugurated 58 sanitation guards tasked with keeping the district clean and healthy, in a move to tackle poor sanitation and youth unemployment simultaneously.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah urges Africa to turn reparations declarations into practical action
results.content: National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, has called on African governments and political leaders to move beyond declarations on reparative justice and pursue practical measures capable of securing redress for historical injustices. He says Africa has made significant progress in building the institutional framework for reparations but must now give the process greater political support and ensure that commitments translate into enforceable remedies. Addressing the Movement for Freedom of Nations Assembly in Moscow on November 16, 2026, Mr Asiedu Nketiah said the African Union had established mechanisms to develop a common position on reparations and was working with Caribbean institutions to coordinate legal analysis and diplomacy.

results.title: Ashantis deserve more than loans of their stolen royal regalia – Asiedu Nketiah
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, says the Asante people deserve more than temporary access to their royal heritage, insisting that the return of looted regalia on loan from British museums cannot be equated with full restitution. He says the distinction between a loan and a transfer of ownership is important in assessing whether communities whose cultural treasures were taken during colonial conquest have received meaningful redress.

results.title: Bono East Regional Minister reaffirms gov’t commitment to infrastructure and job creation at Offuman Fofie Yam Festival
results.content: The Bono East Regional Minister, Francis Owusu Antwi, joined the Paramount Chief of the Offuman Traditional Area, Nana Kwaku Gyan Borokuo II, for the grand durbar of the Offuman Traditional Council’s 2026 Annual Fofie Yam Festival, where he reaffirmed the government's commitment to improving infrastructure and creating jobs.

results.title: Man remanded for allegedly stealing girlfriend’s GH¢18,500
results.content: A 32-year-old man has been remanded into police custody by the Madina District Court for allegedly stealing GH¢18,500 belonging to his girlfriend after she refused to loan him money to start a business.

results.title: Okyenhene files CID compliant against KOANS for alleged publication of false news
results.content: The Okyenhene, Osagyefuo Amoatia Ofori Panin, represented by the Akyem Abuakwa State Secretary, D.M. Ofori-Atta, has filed an official complaint against the Managing Director of KOANS Building Solutions, Mr Kofi Anokye, over the publication of allegedly false and defamatory statements about the traditional ruler on social media.

results.title: South Africa reopens the business of winning Ghanaian travellers and corporate clients
results.content: South Africa is stepping up efforts to rebuild confidence among Ghanaian travellers, business operators and corporate clients, as tourism stakeholders seek to turn recent travel sentiment challenges into renewed commercial opportunities.

results.title: Protect local rice farmers – Dr Bawumia tells government
results.content: The former Vice President and flagbearer of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Dr Mahamudu Bawumia, has called for a decisive shift in national policy to protect local rice producers from rising production costs at home and the falling prices of imported rice.

results.title: Obetsebi Lamptey to Pamprom road to reopen to traffic mid-December – GARID
results.content: The road stretch from the Obetsebi Lamptey Interchange to the Metro Mass area at Pamprom Junction is expected to reopen to motorists between December 15 and 20, 2026, following the completion of 90 per cent of Phase One of the drainage improvement project.

results.title: Ghana to vote for Infantino’s re-election as all 54 CAF nations back FIFA president
results.content: Ghana will vote for Gianni Infantino in the March 2027 FIFA presidential election after all 54 member associations of the Confederation of African Football (CAF), including the Ghana Football Association (GFA), unanimously endorsed the incumbent for another term.

results.title: Mayweather’s Ghana visit offers opportunity to promote boxing, tourism – Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has hosted American boxing legend and promoter Floyd Joy Mayweather Jr. at his residence during the boxer’s visit to Accra this week.

results.title: Ghanaian cyclist takes climate campaign to COP31, calls for youth-led environmental action
results.content: For five years, James Kumbeni has turned his bicycle into an instrument of climate advocacy, cycling across communities to promote environmental awareness and encourage action against carbon emissions.

results.title: Africa is not poor. Africa is under-protected
results.content: Since the Dangote IPO, I have come across a number of articles that start like this: Africa is not xxx. It lacks xxx. I couldn't help but think about this sentiment from an actuarial perspective. The more I thought about it, the more convinced I became that Africa's progress will be greatly helped by closing the protection gap.

results.title: Teacher granted GH¢100,000 bail over alleged sale of unregistered drugs
results.content: An Accra Circuit Court has granted GH¢100,000 bail with two sureties to a teacher arrested over the alleged sale of unregistered drugs.

results.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
results.content: A jury in Los Angeles has found a 30-year-old man guilty of starting one of the most destructive wildfires in California's history.

results.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes ‘fair response’ as he meets UK’s Streeting
results.content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has justified Kyiv's repeated attacks on a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, calling it a "fair response" to 109 separate Russian attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

results.title: Ablakwa elected chair of Nordic-African Foreign Ministers’ Meeting for 2027
results.content: The Minister for Foreign Affairs, Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, has been elected Chair of the Nordic-African Foreign Ministers’ Meeting for 2027.

results.title: AG’s 48-hour detention statement is revolutionary – Abraham Amaliba
results.content: Director-General of the National Road Safety Authority (NRSA), Abraham Amaliba, has described the Attorney General’s directive on the 48-hour detention limit and misconduct by investigative bodies as revolutionary, saying it is the first time an Attorney General has publicly catalogued the challenges confronting the country’s justice delivery system.

results.title: AG directive: Amaliba calls for complaint unit to address misconduct
results.content: Director-General of the National Road Safety Authority (NRSA), Abraham Amaliba, has called on the Attorney General to establish a dedicated complaint unit to receive reports from citizens who experience police misconduct.

results.title: It is an honour to be inducted as Fellow of the Ghana Institute of Architects – Kwame Agbodza
results.content: The Minister for Roads and Highways, Governs Kwame Agbodza, has indicated that it was an honour for him to be inducted as a Fellow of the Ghana Institute of Architects (GIA).

results.title: Kofi Tonto backs purchase of presidential jet but says Ghana should have acquired a bigger aircraft
results.content: A National Communications Member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Kofi Tonto, has defended the government's decision to acquire a new presidential aircraft, arguing that the President deserves adequate security, comfort and protection to perform his official duties.

results.title: KGL Foundation commissions GH¢5m ICT and STEM centre at Aburi Girls
results.content: The KGL Foundation has commissioned a GH¢5 million ICT and STEM Centre at Aburi Girls Senior High School to strengthen students’ access to science and technology education. The commissioning of Phase One of the Caroline Agyemang Dadey ICT and STEM Centre took place on November 20, 2026, as part of the school’s 80th anniversary celebrations. Designed by the school’s 2001 Year Group, the facility is intended to provide students with opportunities for practical learning, digital skills development and innovation in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM). The centre is named after Caroline Agyemang Dadey, Director of the KGL Foundation and a member of the KGL Group of Companies. She is also an alumna of Aburi Girls, having been a member of the Class of 1978. results.title: Manhyia South MP urges AG to introduce legislative guidelines for granting bail
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Manhyia South, Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah, has urged the Attorney-General to go beyond issuing directives on the protection of suspects' rights and introduce clear legislative guidelines to regulate the exercise of discretionary powers in granting bail.

results.title: Preterm birth: Understanding the risks, complications and care for babies born too soon
results.content: Every baby deserves a chance to survive and thrive. But for babies born too early, the journey to survival can be particularly challenging.

results.title: Ghana Prisons Service seeks reforms to strengthen inmate rehabilitation and reintegration
results.content: The Ghana Prisons Service has called for comprehensive reforms to strengthen its correctional system, improve inmate rehabilitation and reposition the institution as a key part of the country’s national security architecture.

results.title: AG must publish quarterly figures on police detention breaches – Victoria Bright
results.content: International corporate lawyer and entrepreneur Victoria Bright has urged the Attorney General to publish quarterly reports detailing violations of the constitutional 48-hour detention limit by law enforcement officers, saying the move is necessary to ensure accountability under the new directive on arrest, detention and prosecution.

results.title: NaCCA urges international schools to integrate Ghanaian values into curricula
results.content: The National Council for Curriculum and Assessment (NaCCA) has urged international curriculum providers and schools operating in Ghana to incorporate Ghanaian cultural values and local contexts into their teaching programmes.

results.title: Ga West Education Directorate celebrates International Children’s Day, calls for greater protection of children’s rights
results.content: The Ga West Education Directorate has joined the global community to celebrate International Children’s Day, calling on parents, teachers and caregivers to provide safe, inclusive and supportive environments that promote the holistic development of children.
